svg.text: NEMA14 CH32X035G8U6 | USB-C PD & Logic Power
A4 landscape | 1 / 3 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: Open-drain PG is active low. DP/DM short: PD-only mode.
R_PD + C_PD supply/filter the negotiation IC.

svg.text: Schottky diodes accept either supply and block crossfeed.

text.tspan: U_LDO / HT7533-1 supplies the low-current CH32 logic.
30 V operating input, 33 V absolute maximum.
Input spikes and mounted thermal margins remain bench gates.
